markdown:
# PHC inspection interviews: daily practice, mock interviews, model answers and readiness

During an inspection the Punjab Healthcare Commission's surveyors do not only read documents: for 72 compliance
requirements of the MSDS (2024 revision) the Evidence column says **Interview**, so they ask the nurse, the lab
technician, the radiographer, the sanitary worker what they do. Haspataal already prints the documents those
indicators need (the [inspection pack](phc-inspection.md)); this workflow gets the **people** ready.

Every establishment rehearses the questions of **its own manual** (the category recorded in Settings, facility): a
clinic or a smaller hospital gets the Category I questions whose indicator its manual also has (`indicators_in_category`
is never empty), plus its manual's own interviews where Category I has none: the Clinic manual's indicators 11 (fire and
other emergencies), 35 (the prescription handed over) and 41 (consent before examination, VCO), and the Category II C
manual's 60 (emergency triage and SOPs) and 63 (the transfusion law). Those rows carry `framework` `Clinic` or `IIC`,
no `phc_type` (a Category I notion) and their manual's `grade` (Red: full compliance, Yellow: at least 80 %). The server
filters by the category: never filter by framework in the app. A change of category changes the deck at once; the
rehearsals and mock interviews already recorded stay as they were.

| Who | Permission | What they do |
|---|---|---|
| Every member of staff | `msds.interview.practice` (every role except the PHC inspector) | rehearse the questions of their roles: question of the day, flashcards, progress, pocket guide |
| Supervisors: head nurse, department heads, IPC nurse, quality officer, management | `msds.interview.conduct` | run mock interviews, raise corrective actions for gaps in practice, read the readiness |
| Quality officer, Owner, Hospital Admin | `msds.interview.manage` | adapt the model answers to the hospital's SOPs, mark questions not applicable, read the readiness |

The question bank (78 questions) ships with the server: one entry for each of the 72 interview requirements and six the
surveyors commonly ask although the manual names another evidence (`beyond_filter`: hand hygiene, fire extinguishers,
patient identity, access to records, sterilisation, expiry dates). Each has the question in the surveyor's words, other
ways of asking it, a model answer, the key points a good answer covers, follow-up probes, pitfalls, what to show and
references. The PHC type comes from the colour of the indicator's banner in the manual: **Mandatory** (red) or
**Operational** (yellow); show it as a word with its colour, never the colour alone.

**Honesty first.** The answers describe what the hospital's SOPs say and what the staff actually do. Never present them
as a script to memorise; under every answer show "If a key point is not true on your ward, tell your in-charge: it is a
gap to fix, not a line to learn." A gap found in a mock interview becomes a corrective action.

**The hospital's own facts.** A model answer quotes the hospital's settings and records through placeholders, for
example "the doctor countersigns it within {{verbal_order_countersign_hours}} hours". The API fills them in
(`model_answer`) and lists them (`facts`: label, value, `set`, `where` to set it); a fact not set yet prints as a
bracketed prompt. Never fill one with an invented value.

**English and Urdu.** The whole bank is in both languages: the question, its variants, the model answer (with the same
placeholders), the key points, the follow-ups, the pitfalls, what to show; the chapter names, the fact labels and units
("24 گھنٹے", "10 منٹ") and the notice under every answer too. What the PHC publishes in English stays in English: the
requirement's text, the indicator's label, the references and whom the surveyor asks; so do medicine names, test names
and what the hospital typed into its records. Every read below takes `lang=en|ur`; without it the server uses the user's
language preference (`PUT /settings/me` `{"language": "ur"}`, read back in `/auth/me`), and every answer says its `lang`.

| Field | Use |
|---|---|
| `lang` | the language the texts are in: switch the layout with it |
| `direction` | `rtl` for Urdu: lay the card out right to left in Noto Nastaliq Urdu (bundle it in the app) |
| `text_status` | `Original` (English), `Draft` (the Urdu bank until the vendor's native-speaker review: show "Draft translation" beside the answer), `Reviewed` |
| `question_en` | the English wording a surveyor may use: show it small under the Urdu question |
| `notice` | the honesty notice in the card's language |
| `adapted_languages` | the languages the hospital adapted this answer in |

Offer an English / اردو switch on every card (it sends `lang`); remember the user's choice with `PUT /settings/me`.

## 1. Daily practice (every member of staff)

1. The login card: `GET /msds/interview-prep/my-deck?limit=20`. Show `question_of_the_day` with a "Practise" button
   (hide the card when it is null). `due` is the deck, the most urgent first: not known (DidNotKnow, Partly), then never
   rehearsed (Mandatory first), then known ones due again; `counts` gives the tiles.
2. A flashcard: `GET /msds/interview-prep/questions/{key}`. Show `question` and, on "Ask it differently", one of
   `variants`. The user answers aloud or in their head, then "Show the answer" reveals `model_answer` and the
   `key_points` as a checklist; `follow_ups` as "The surveyor may ask next", `pitfalls` as "Avoid", `show_me` as "Be
   ready to show", and the `documents` (the inspection documents that evidence the indicator, each with its `pdf_url`).
3. The rating: `POST /msds/interview-prep/rehearsals`
   ```json
   { "question_key": "I-055-ii", "rating": "Partly" }
   ```
   `Knew`, `Partly` or `DidNotKnow` (the user's own judgement against the key points). The answer carries `next_due`
   (tomorrow when not known, in 3 days when partly, in 7 days when known, then doubling up to 60) and `due_left`.
   `INTERVIEW_QUESTION_NOT_APPLICABLE`: the hospital took the question out, drop the card.
4. Progress: `GET /msds/interview-prep/my-progress`: `ready_pct` (the share of my questions rated Knew), `streak_days`,
   per chapter knew / partly / not known / not rehearsed, and `last_mock_interview` with its score (open it:
   `GET /msds/interview-prep/mock-interviews/{mock_interview_id}`).
5. Browse: `GET /msds/interview-prep/questions?mine=true` (my roles), or any role from `GET /msds/interview-prep/roles`;
   filters `area`, `indicator`, `phc_type`, `search`. Each row has `framework`, `grade` and `indicators_in_category`,
   the indicator's number(s) in the establishment's own PHC category (a Category II hospital or a clinic sees its
   manual's numbers). Show `phc_type` when it is set (Category I) and the grade otherwise.
6. The pocket guide: `GET /msds/interview-prep/pocket-guide/pdf?role=ward_nurse` (default: my first role), a PDF of the
   role's questions with the key points and the model answers, the facts filled in, for the ward notice board and the
   shift huddle. One click, one PDF. The PDF is English: the server's PDFs print Latin script only. The Urdu guide is a
   print payload the app lays out and the terminal prints, as the Urdu consent forms and the complaints notice are:
   `GET /msds/interview-prep/pocket-guide?role=ward_nurse&lang=ur`
   ```json
   { "lang": "ur", "direction": "rtl", "text_status": "Draft", "role": "ward_nurse", "role_name": "Ward Nurse",
     "hospital": { "name": "…", "address": "…", "phone": "…", "phc_number": "…" },
     "title": "PHC معائنے کا انٹرویو: Ward Nurse کے لیے جیبی رہنما", "intro": ["…", "…"], "notice": "…",
     "columns": ["اچھے جواب میں کیا ہونا چاہیے", "نمونہ جواب"], "footer": "…",
     "questions": [ { "key": "I-055-ii", "indicator": 55, "phc_type": "Mandatory", "heading": "اشاریہ 55 (لازمی) · …",
                      "question": "…", "key_points": ["…"], "model_answer": "… 24 گھنٹے کے اندر …",
                      "answer_source": "Standard" } ] }
   ```
   Print `heading`, then a two-column table (`columns`: the key points as bullets, the model answer) per question; the
   title, the hospital and `intro` on top, `notice` and `footer` at the bottom, and "Draft translation" while
   `text_status` is Draft.

The user's own mock interviews: `GET /msds/interview-prep/mock-interviews` lists only theirs unless they conduct or
manage mock interviews. The `msds.mock_interview.recorded` event tells them a new one was recorded.

## 2. Mock interviews (supervisors)

1. Pick the member of staff: `GET /msds/interview-prep/staff?role=ward_nurse&search=` (active employees with or without a
   login: the surveyors question sanitary and kitchen staff too; `is_me` greyed, nobody examines themselves).
2. Plan: `GET /msds/interview-prep/mock-interviews/plan?employee_id=88&role=ward_nurse&count=6`: the questions with the
   `reason` each was picked (missed at the last mock interview, not known when rehearsed, never rehearsed: Mandatory
   first). The examiner may swap any for another of the role (`GET /msds/interview-prep/questions?role=ward_nurse`).
   Add `lang=ur` to put the questions in Urdu (the reasons follow): ask in the language the member of staff works in,
   as the surveyors do.
3. Hold it: one question at a time with its key points for the examiner (`GET /msds/interview-prep/questions/{key}`);
   the model answer stays behind a toggle and is never shown to the person questioned.
4. Record it once at the end: `POST /msds/interview-prep/mock-interviews` with an `Idempotency-Key`
   ```json
   { "employee_id": 88, "role": "ward_nurse", "note": "Ward 3, night shift",
     "items": [
       { "question_key": "I-064-ii", "result": "Met" },
       { "question_key": "I-084-i-j", "result": "PartlyMet", "note": "Did not know the 24-hour storage limit" },
       { "question_key": "I-055-ii", "result": "NotMet", "note": "Verbal orders are never read back on this ward",
         "action": { "action_type": "Corrective", "description": "Teach read-back of verbal orders on ward 3; audit 10 orders",
                     "owner_user_id": 41, "due_date": "2026-10-31" } } ] }
   ```
   A note is required unless Met (`VALIDATION_ERROR`). `action` only with PartlyMet or NotMet, and only when the answer
   shows a gap in **practice** (the SOP is not followed, equipment is missing): it goes to the hospital's action register
   (`GET /quality/actions?source=MockInterview`) with its owner and due date; the owner must have a login (`user_id` from
   step 1). The answer carries the score (`score_pct`: Met 1, PartlyMet half), the items and the actions. The member of
   staff is notified. `MOCK_INTERVIEW_SELF`: nobody examines themselves.
   An item's action names its owner from `GET /msds/interview-prep/staff` (`user_id`) and its department from
   `GET /admin/departments`.
5. History: `GET /msds/interview-prep/mock-interviews?employee_id=&role=` and
   `GET /msds/interview-prep/mock-interviews/{mock_interview_id}?lang=` (the items' questions in that language).

## 3. The model answers (Quality Officer)

1. The bank: `GET /msds/interview-prep/questions` (all 78; `adapted` and `applicable` flags) and
   `GET /msds/interview-prep/questions/{key}`: `standard_answer` with its `{{placeholders}}`, `model_answer` filled, the
   `facts` (a fact not set links to `where`, e.g. "Setting verbal_order_countersign_hours (PUT /admin/settings/...)"), the
   `standard_key_points`, the `hospital_version` when there is one.
2. Adapt an answer to the hospital's SOP: `PUT /msds/interview-prep/questions/{key}/hospital-answer`
   ```json
   { "lang": "en",
     "model_answer": "On our wards a verbal order is taken only in an emergency; I write it on the MAR, read it back and the doctor countersigns within {{verbal_order_countersign_hours}} hours.",
     "key_points": ["Only in an emergency", "Written, read back, confirmed", "Countersigned within the set hours"],
     "note": "Nursing SOP NUR-07, approved by the nursing superintendent", "expected_version": null }
   ```
   It may quote the same facts (`VALIDATION_ERROR` with `details.facts` for an unknown one). Null answer or key points =
   the bank's text again. Send `hospital_version.row_version` as `expected_version` (`VERSION_CONFLICT`: reload); every
   change is kept as history.
   **Each language on its own:** `lang` says which language the answer and the key points are in (default `en`); the
   other language keeps its own version (`hospital_version` has `model_answer` / `key_points` for English and
   `model_answer_ur` / `key_points_ur` for Urdu). Give the editor an English / اردو switch (`GET .../questions/{key}?lang=`).
   When `adapted_languages` names one language only, show "Adapted in English only: adapt the Urdu too" (or the other
   way round), so a nurse who rehearses in Urdu reads the hospital's SOP and not the bank's text. The Urdu bank is a draft
   (`text_status`) until the vendor's native-speaker review: the quality officer may correct any Urdu answer here.
3. A question that does not apply here (no imaging department, no blood bank): the same call with
   `"applicable": false, "not_applicable_reason": "No blood bank: blood comes from the Regional Blood Centre"`. It leaves
   the decks, the pocket guides and the readiness.
4. Review every answer with the department heads before the staff rehearse: the bank's answers are a starting point
   written from the MSDS, WHO guidance, the PNRA regulations, DRAP's recall guidelines and the Hospital Waste Management
   Rules 2005.

## 4. Readiness (Quality Officer, management, supervisors)

`GET /msds/interview-prep/readiness?role=` (`msds.interview.manage` or `conduct`):

* `totals`: staff, started, ready %, mock interviews in the last 90 days and their score;
* `roles`: per role the active staff, how many started, the average ready %, `not_started` (names), the mock interviews
  and their score; a "Pocket guide" button per role (`GET /msds/interview-prep/pocket-guide/pdf?role=`);
* `weakest`: the 10 questions the staff know least (DidNotKnow, Partly, mock NotMet and PartlyMet counts): teach them in
  the next huddle;
* `facts_not_set`: the settings and records the answers quote that are not set yet (show first, in amber: the staff
  would rehearse a bracketed prompt instead of the hospital's figure);
* `adapted_in_one_language`: the answers the hospital adapted in English or Urdu only (`key`, `adapted_languages`):
  link each to the answer editor.

`lang` sets the language of the weakest questions and the fact labels. A "Pocket guide" button per role opens the PDF
(English) or the Urdu payload (`GET /msds/interview-prep/pocket-guide?role=&lang=ur`).

Refresh on `msds.mock_interview.recorded`. This is the hospital's internal preparation: the PHC inspector's role has no
permission for any of it; never show it in the `inspection` workspace.

## The facts the answers quote

Settings (`PUT /admin/settings/{key}`): `lab_turnaround_routine_minutes`, `lab_turnaround_emergency_minutes`,
`critical_result_communicate_minutes`, `er_triage_target_minutes`, `er_admission_wait_minutes`,
`er_referral_wait_minutes`, `verbal_order_countersign_hours`, `mar_on_time_window_minutes`, the pharmacy temperature
ranges, `near_expiry_alert_days`, `ot_recovery_min_score`, `estimate_due_hours`, the complaint deadlines and
`complaint_desk`, `incident_review_hours`, `sentinel_analysis_days`, `drill_interval_months`, `orientation_due_days`,
the appraisal intervals, `staff_rights_statement`, `hospital_mission_statement` (new: MSDS ROM 108) and
`hospital_head_employee_id`. Records: the triage levels, the high-alert medicines and the look-alike / sound-alike pairs,
the sentinel event list, the last mock drill, the quality officers, the quality and waste management committees, the
police stations and the medico-legal case types.

## Errors

| Code | When | The UI |
|---|---|---|
| `INTERVIEW_QUESTION_UNKNOWN` | a key not in the bank | reload the list |
| `INTERVIEW_QUESTION_NOT_APPLICABLE` | rehearsing a question the hospital took out | drop the card, refresh the deck |
| `MOCK_INTERVIEW_SELF` | a supervisor plans or records their own mock interview | ask another supervisor |
| `VERSION_CONFLICT` | adapting an answer someone else changed | reload, then edit again |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | a note missing on PartlyMet / NotMet, an action on Met, an unknown fact in an answer, an unknown role | show `details` |

## For the coding agents

The MCP tools `get_interview_prep_brief`, `list_interview_questions(role, area, indicator, lang)` and
`get_interview_question(key, lang)` serve the same bank in English and Urdu, the facts catalogue and the rules;
`get_screen` for `interview_practice`, `mock_interviews`, `interview_bank`, `interview_readiness`.
